description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC Controller named OptionsController for managing product options in an admin web interface, including listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting product options.

classes.name: OptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing product options in admin interface, including listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting options.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display list of product options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display edit form for a specific product option.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and displays the product option form for creation or editing.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a product option.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles POST request to return paginated list of options in JSON format.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets menu attributes for the view.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a product option.
